name: CMOS delay-XOR frequency doubler
description: An RC-delayed clock, two delay inverters and a transmission-gate XOR generate a positive pulse on each rising and falling input edge. Fourteen MOS devices, a 20 kohm/1 pF delay and a 100 fF output load are explicit. A 100 ns input period gives about 50 ns between pulses; both polarities, quiet intervals and widths are checked. This uses XOR of original and delayed states, unlike a rising-edge-only qualifier. Educational nominal models; duty distortion, calibrated pulse width, hazards and PVT are not qualified.
